name: Cat Familiar
body:
CAT FAMILIAR (FIGMENT)

Wizard 12
N Tiny magical beast
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 14, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +6 natural, +2 size)
hp 20
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +9
Defensive Abilities recurring dream; SR 17

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (good)
Melee 2 claws +10 (1d2–4), bite +10 (1d3–4)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 3, Dex 15, Con 8, Int 11, Wis 12, Cha 7
Base Atk +6; CMB +6; CMD 12 (16 vs. trip)
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Climb +6, Knowledge (arcana) +12, Perception +5, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth
SQ empathic link, manifest dreams (flight), share spells, speak with master

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Familiar

The master of a cat familiar gains a +3 bonus on Stealth checks.
